root_cause: V3 authored hair geometry in fixed canvas coordinates derived from the master-like pose instead of deriving head/shoulder/torso anchors from the canonical promoted B3B body pose. The master and production body are not in the same pose, so even improved hair massing cannot align correctly.
observed_failures: hair crown and fall geometry do not follow the actual B3B head/shoulder orientation
rear mass is positioned as if the body shared the master pose
front locks frame an imagined master-like pose rather than the production sprite pose
visual mismatch remains obvious even though rear/front ownership is structurally correct
route_correction: all hair geometry must be authored from pose anchors measured from the actual canonical B3B body alpha/silhouette
contact sheet must expose detected body pose anchors before visual promotion can be considered
